channel.title: Ben's Daily Digest
channel.description: A personalized daily headline digest across Ben's core interests, local NYC-metro news, and a rotating set of adjacent topics.

item.title: [Soccer] From near oblivion to Europe - Brighton celebrate 125th anniversary
item.description: From obscurity and near oblivion to Premier League and Europe - Brighton celebrate their 125th anniversary.

item.title: [Soccer] Winless Villa and Spurs face telling early showdown
item.description: Aston Villa and Tottenham are winless in the Premier League - and both in need of inspiration as they prepare to face each other on Saturday.

item.title: [Tech & AI] India forces caller-ID apps to feed spam reports to telcos
item.description: Truecaller says the one-way sharing requirement would hand a commercially valuable proprietary asset to telecom operators.

item.title: [Tech & AI] Tilly Norwood’s press tour is going about as well as you’d expect for an AI
item.description: In one particularly odd interview, Norwood seems to malfunction and begin speaking Chinese.

item.title: [Streaming / Music Biz] Billboard’s Music Industry Events Calendar
item.description: A complete rundown of the most important events across the music business.

item.title: [Tech & AI] A startup that builds other startups raised $100M and is all-in on physical AI
item.description: UP.Labs, now doing business under the name Vantora, is building startups for industrial corporations.

item.title: [Tech & AI] Anthropic is operating a lab that conducts biology experiments
item.description: AI leaders have been promising that AI is the key to curing human disease. Anthropic researchers have also been warning that AI might kill us all.

item.title: [Soccer] 'We're unpredictable' - Andrews delighted with 'brilliant' Brentford
item.description: Brentford manager Keith Andrews is full of praise after a resounding 3-0 win against West London rivals Chelsea, branding them "brilliant" following a unbeaten start to the Premier League campaign.

item.title: [Soccer] Brentford stay unbeaten as they put three past Chelsea
item.description: Brentford maintain their unbeaten start in the Premier League as they score three second-half goals to beat Chelsea 3-0 at the Gtech Community Stadium.

item.title: [Soccer] Arsenal open to Dowman loan in right circumstances
item.description: Arsenal are open to allowing teenage prodigy Max Dowman to leave the club on loan this term if it aids his development.

item.title: [NYC Metro] Family of man beaten to death by NY prison guards to receive $24 million
item.description: A still from body worn camera footage showing state correction officers using force against Robert Brooks. Robert Brooks' beating death was captured on corrections officers' body-worn cameras. [ more › ]

item.title: [NYC Metro] Students sue Columbia over protest, saying guards locked them in library for hours
item.description: Columbia University The federal class-action suit accuses campus security of holding roughly 80 people inside a reading room at Butler Library and beating some of them, and then punishing them to satisfy the Trump administration. [ more › ]

item.title: [NYC Metro] MTA loses bid to eliminate mandatory staffing of subway token booths
item.description: A subway token booth at the Coney Island station in 2018. The MTA had sought to implement a policy of leaving token booths locked and unstaffed if the scheduled station agent called out sick or was on vacation. [ more › ]
